items.source: Once you have access to the SetupContext object in your Module, you can do all sorts of cool things to configure Jackson’s JSON mapping. You can read more about how Module instances work on Jackson’s wiki.
items.translation: 一旦在您的Module中获得了SetupContext对象的访问权限，您就可以利用它来配置 Jackson 的 JSON 映射，实现各种有趣的功能。有关Module实例的工作原理，您可以在Jackson 的 Wiki上阅读更多详细信息。

items.source: Spring Data REST returns a representation of a domain object that corresponds to the Accept type specified in the HTTP request.
items.translation: Spring Data REST 返回与 HTTP 请求中指定的 `Accept` 类型相对应的领域对象表示。

items.source: Sometimes, the behavior of the Spring Data REST ObjectMapper (which has been specially configured to use intelligent serializers that can turn domain objects into links and back again) may not handle your domain model correctly. There are so many ways you can structure your data that you may find your own domain model is not translated to JSON correctly. It is also sometimes not practical in these cases to try and support a complex domain model in a generic way. Sometimes, depending on the complexity, it is not even possible to offer a generic solution.
items.translation: 有时，Spring Data REST 的 ObjectMapper（该对象 mapper 已专门配置为使用智能序列化器，可将领域对象转换为链接并反向转换）可能无法正确处理您的领域模型。由于数据结构的组织方式多种多样，您可能会发现自身的领域模型无法被正确转换为 JSON。在这些情况下，尝试以通用方式支持复杂的领域模型往往也不切实际。有时，根据复杂程度的不同，甚至无法提供通用的解决方案。

items.source: In a default configuration, Jackson has no idea what class to instantiate when POSTing new data to the exporter. This is something you need to tell Jackson either through an annotation, or (more cleanly) by registering a type mapping by using a Module.
items.translation: 在默认配置下，Jackson 无法确定在通过 POST 向导出器发送新数据时应实例化哪个类。您需要通过注解告知 Jackson，或者（更优雅地）通过使用 `<code>` 模块注册类型映射来告知它。

items.source: Currently, only JSON representations are supported. Other representation types can be supported in the future by adding an appropriate converter and updating the controller methods with the appropriate content-type.
items.translation: 目前仅支持 JSON 格式。未来可通过添加合适的转换器并更新控制器方法以设置相应的 Content-Type，来支持其他表示类型。

items.source: To accommodate the largest percentage of use cases, Spring Data REST tries very hard to render your object graph correctly. It tries to serialize unmanaged beans as normal POJOs, and it tries to create links to managed beans where necessary. However, if your domain model does not easily lend itself to reading or writing plain JSON, you may want to configure Jackson’s ObjectMapper with your own custom mappings, serializers, and deserializers.
items.translation: 为了尽可能适配各种使用场景，Spring Data REST 会竭尽全力正确地渲染您的对象图。它会尝试将未管理的 Bean 序列化为普通的 POJO，并在必要时为受管理的 Bean 创建链接。然而，如果您的领域模型并不适合直接读取或写入纯 JSON，您可能希望配置 Jackson 的 ObjectMapper，使用自定义的映射、序列化器和反序列化器。
